raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-17 payments-source sends reversals as separate REVERSAL rows and no longer updates the original, so the original stays POSTED. The pipeline keeps the original (status = 'POSTED') and drops the REVERSAL row, so reversed amounts are counted in gold totals, which are overstated on recent days. The fix is to exclude POSTED originals that a REVERSAL row points to, matching the pre-change convention where reversed originals were excluded on their own txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND txn_id NOT IN (SELECT orig_txn_id FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL);"}}
